nodes.name: Sklearn Covariance Robust FastMCD Selection Helper Atoms
nodes.description: Deterministic multivariate FastMCD trial planning, candidate ranking and gathering, large-sample scheduling, and merged-result placement before the deferred c-step subset search.

nodes.name: fast_mcd_trial_plan
nodes.description: Resolve whether FastMCD runs from random supports or supplied location and covariance estimates, and how many starts it executes.

nodes.name: fast_mcd_best_candidate_indices
nodes.description: Rank FastMCD candidate estimates by determinant and select the requested best indices.

nodes.name: fast_mcd_gather_best_candidates
nodes.description: Gather the selected FastMCD candidate tensors by ranked index.
nodes.type_signature: (locations: NDArray[np.float64], covariances: NDArray[np.float64], supports: NDArray[np.bool_], distances: NDArray[np.float64], indices: NDArray[np.int64]) -> tuple[NDArray[np.float64], NDArray[np.float64], NDArray[np.bool_], NDArray[np.float64]]

nodes.name: fast_mcd_large_sample_schedule
nodes.description: Compute the deterministic constants used by sklearn's large-sample multivariate FastMCD branch.
nodes.type_signature: (n_samples: int, n_features: int, n_support: int) -> tuple[int, int, int, int, int, int, int, int, int, int]

outputs.name: result
outputs.type_desc: tuple[int, int, int, int, int, int, int, int, int, int]

nodes.name: fast_mcd_place_merged_results
nodes.description: Place merged-set support flags and distances back into full-length sample arrays.
nodes.type_signature: (n_samples: int, selection: NDArray[np.int64], merged_support: NDArray[np.bool_], merged_distances: NDArray[np.float64]) -> tuple[NDArray[np.bool_], NDArray[np.float64]]
